goal: Electronics for a double inverted pendulum on a rack-and-pinion cart, laid out on a breadboard: a Teensy 4.1 drives a 12 V DC gearmotor through a DRV8874 H-bridge (IN1 on pin 2, IN2 on pin 3, PMODE and SLEEP to 3.3 V). Two AS5600 magnetic encoders read the two joint angles over I2C (one on Wire: SDA 18 / SCL 19, one on Wire1: SDA 17 / SCL 16). Two VL53L0X distance sensors measure the cart position (one on each I2C bus). A 12 V supply feeds the DRV8874 VIN; a 12 V to 3.3 V regulator powers the four sensors.

plan.title: Double Inverted Pendulum Cart Controller with Teensy 4.1
plan.summary: This circuit controls a balancing double inverted pendulum on a moving cart. A Teensy 4.1 reads joint angles from two magnetic encoders and cart distance from two optical sensors across two separate I2C buses, then commands a 12 V gearmotor through a DRV8874 motor driver.
plan.final_result: A compact, noise-isolated dual-bus control circuit. The Teensy 4.1 concurrently polls the pivot encoder and primary distance sensor on Wire (pins 18/19) and the elbow encoder and secondary distance sensor on Wire1 (pins 17/16). It calculates the balancing state space matrix and produces PWM commands on pins 2 and 3 to drive the cart via the DRV8874 H-bridge.
safety: Always disconnect the 12 V power adapter before modifying any breadboard wire or module connection.
Do not connect 12 V directly to any Teensy pin or sensor board; all Teensy I/O pins are 3.3 V tolerant only.
Keep hands, loose wires, and tools clear of the gear rack and swinging pendulum arms when power is applied.

part_guide.bb1: Solderless breadboard. Holes connect horizontally in numbered rows across the center groove; top and bottom rows form continuous power rails.
part_guide.teensy1: Teensy 4.1 micro-controller. High-speed 600 MHz board that runs the pendulum balancing control equations.
part_guide.drv1: DRV8874 H-bridge motor driver. Takes logic signals from the Teensy and delivers up to 2.1 A to the 12 V drive motor.

part_guide.vl53_1: VL53L0X time-of-flight laser distance sensor. Measures cart distance from the rail end on I2C bus 0.
part_guide.as5600_2: Second AS5600 magnetic angle sensor. Measures the angle of the second elbow joint on I2C bus 1.
part_guide.vl53_2: Second VL53L0X distance sensor. Measures cart clearance on the opposing rail limit on I2C bus 1.

Both VL53L0X sensors share the fixed address 0x29 but reside on separate I2C buses alongside their respective encoder.

plan.final_result: A compact, noise-isolated dual-bus control circuit. The Teensy 4.1 concurrently polls the pivot encoder and primary distance sensor on Wire (pins 18/19) and the elbow encoder and secondary distance sensor on Wire1 (pins 17/16). It calculates the balancing state space matrix and produces PWM commands on pins 2 and 3 to drive the cart via the DRV8874 H-bridge.
safety: Always disconnect the 12 V power adapter before modifying any breadboard wire or module connection.
Do not connect 12 V directly to any Teensy pin or sensor board; all Teensy I/O pins are 3.3 V tolerant only.
Keep hands, loose wires, and tools clear of the gear rack and swinging pendulum arms when power is applied.
